v1_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE review concept board for OCTARINE STORAGE UNIT in Runic Storage, a Core Keeper mod.
Reference image 1 is current art family: the Octarine unit is top row far right. Preserve its squat rectangular blue-gray stone/metal housing, dark teal outer frame, broad flat top with inset small teal rune, lower front inset teal crystal and chunky support ribs. This is a storage cabinet, NOT a crafting bench, treasure chest with curved lid, furnace, computer, or altar.
Reference image 2 TOP ROW is authoritative native camera: workbenchWood_down, electronicsTable_down, chestAncient. Use front-facing top-visible orthographic game sprite projection. Zero yaw, zero roll: all front/rear edges perfectly horizontal and left/right edges vertical, no diagonal isometric rotation, no visible left/right side wall. Compact almost square silhouette and short base. Top occupies roughly upper half, front lower half.
Reference image 3 approved gem board: Octarine gem is top right. Echo its broad teal faceted shape, dark teal socket and one tiny gold fastener. Preserve tier color.
Revamp the storage unit with subtle tier flavor while keeping the current family: darker ocean-teal corner clamps, one readable angular turquoise inset rune on the blue-gray top slab, a broad emerald-teal front gem recessed between two stout ribs, tiny aged-brass retaining stud below gem. Make the top feel thick and the front recess dark. No tentacles, leaves, spikes, floating crystals, long legs, tiny ornamental runes or clutter. Original composition, not a copy of native sprites.
Style: chunky deliberate pixel-art clusters suited to eventual 16x16 sprite cleanup, roughly 16 purposeful pixel steps across object, restrained 3-4 tones per material, colored dark edges, warm top-left highlights and cool underside shadow; no smooth gradients, photoreal detail, heavy glow, noisy texture or antialiasing.
Charcoal board, one prominent design left and a smaller readability rendition right. Exact title "RUNIC STORAGE — OCTARINE UNIT". Small label "Tier accent concept". Footer "Concept only • native-pixel cleanup follows". Do not label the smaller rendition as 1x or 16x16; no grids or dimension claims. Leave plenty of negative space.
